picks.file: Ponte vicino alla città di Ravenna sotto di cui passano i fiumi Ronco e Montone uniti e allontanati dalla detta città by Giovanni Domenico Campiglia (1739).png
picks.what: The bridge over the Ronco and Montone with the city beyond, etching
picks.why: view across the river to the city’s towers and bell towers; caption trimmed

picks.what: Santa Maria in Porto and the old racecourse, aerial photograph
picks.why: aerial view of a part of the city with the basilica and its monastery; top trimmed to drop a dark object in the frame

gaps: P0: nothing (#1 is a later photo of San Vitale with an inventory number read as a date); P1: battle scenes and a Coronelli map with a small street plan; P3: only sarcophagus drawings; P6: nothing (#20 is a distant haze from Montefiore Conca, #21–22 a suburban road, #23 a mosaic interior)
notes: In #8 the city is small in the background, but it is a true view labeled with Ravenna. #19 (Edward Bawden, 1945, Piazza Garibaldi during a military ceremony) is a color alternative for P5 if an event view is preferred. P6 is still needed: a modern photo of San Vitale or the old center should be sought separately.
